hero.name: Afsal Ahmed Khan A
hero.tagline: Turning ideas into apps, games, and AI-powered experiences.

about.bio: 3rd-year AIML student at Jerusalem College of Engineering, Chennai. Winner of Cipher Quest (1st Place) and PALS Think2Impact Jury Award. Participated in AMD Slingshot Campus Days, Cyber Connect Hackathon, and multiple AI innovation programs. Building Android apps, full-stack web products, cognitive AI systems, and Unity games.

achievements.title: AMD Slingshot Campus Days Ideathon Participant

projects.title: Aether: Personal Cognitive Architecture
projects.description: Long-term cognitive architecture & second mind system that continuously learns, evolves, and maintains an evidence-based model of user identity using Deno, Supabase PostgreSQL with pgvector, and Gemini 2.5.

projects.title: SignBridge AI (Hackathon Project)
projects.description: Real-time sign language translation platform bridging communication gaps using client-side MediaPipe WASM, TensorFlow.js neural network (27 ASL/ISL gesture classes), anti-flicker filters, Gemini LLM, and 9-language speech synthesis.

projects.title: Aether Console Dashboard
projects.description: High-fidelity dark glassmorphic telemetry console and developer client for the Aether Chat cognitive ecosystem, featuring real-time reasoning drawers, latency dashboards, and knowledge graph visualizers.

projects.title: Musubi: Autonomous Life Intelligence
projects.description: Fully autonomous personal life intelligence system and living second brain that automatically extracts life data from natural conversation, connects unrelated insights, and runs cross-platform on Web, Android, and Windows.

projects.title: Wardrobe AI
projects.description: Private wardrobe inventory management and intelligent outfit recommendation app in Flutter & Dart. Features algorithmic outfit compatibility scoring based on color, pattern, wear frequency, and weather.

projects.title: Cipher Quest OS / Treasure Hunt
projects.description: Interactive virtual web operating system and hackathon platform featuring an in-browser Monaco Code Editor IDE, interactive Terminal, File Manager, Riddle Solver, Task Manager, and real-time Supabase backend.

projects.title: Smart Attendance PWA
projects.description: Multi-role college attendance tracking and verification system with dedicated portals for Students, Class Representatives, Teachers, and Administrators, featuring offline-first PWA caching and JWT verification.

projects.title: Fox Tale (2D Platformer Adventure)
projects.description: Feature-packed 2D adventure platformer game in Unity Engine. Includes overworld level selection map, boss tank battles with mine/bullet hazards, flying enemies, checkpoints, moving platforms, and audio management.

projects.title: Kitchen Chaos 3D
projects.description: 3D co-op style culinary simulation game built in Unity Engine with C# and Universal Render Pipeline (URP). Includes interactive cutting/frying counters, recipe ScriptableObjects, customer order flow, and WebGL support.

projects.title: Tic Tac Toe WebGL (Minimax AI)
projects.description: Polished 2D retro pixel-art Tic Tac Toe game supporting Single Player against an unbeatable Minimax AI algorithm, Local 2-Player mode, retro chiptune audio, and WebGL web deployment.

projects.title: Valen: Interactive Proposal Web App
projects.description: Playful interactive web application featuring erratic evasive button physics, spring scale motion, canvas confetti particle bursts, and reactive micro-interactions.

projects.title: 2D Open World RPG Engine
projects.description: Expansive 2D open-world game built in Unity Engine with C# and URP. Features player movement physics, animal & enemy AI pathfinding, inventory drop systems, and multi-scene level transitions.

projects.title: 2D Precision Physics Platformer
projects.description: Precision 2D platformer game in Unity Engine featuring custom 2D physics materials (friction & slippy physics), double jumping, wall sliding, hazard spike traps, coin collectibles, and level UI.

projects.title: 2D Top-Down Action RPG
projects.description: Action RPG featuring top-down directional movement, melee sword combat, enemy AI state machines, dynamic health bars, and dungeon tilemap levels.

projects.title: ARISE IRL
projects.description: Solo Leveling-themed calisthenics RPG Android app. Full gamification with XP, levels, quests, Supabase backend, and Gemini AI coaching.

projects.title: NeuroCart
projects.description: AI-powered adaptive shopping assistant built for AMD Slingshot Campus Days Chennai Hackathon. React + Vite + Supabase, deployed on Google Cloud Run.

projects.title: Magic Embroidery
projects.description: Production ecommerce site for a Chennai embroidery business. Full product catalog, cart, order flow, and admin panel.

projects.title: Aash Player
projects.description: Offline Android music player in Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Pro equalizer, Mini Capsule overlay, Dynamic Light for Vivo, and lock screen controls.
